Description.description: An immutable record of a privileged lifecycle command (AD-003). Every command writes exactly one audit event as it commits (BR-012, NFR-AUD-01, FR-033), capturing the command, target, actor, correlation id and idempotency key. Audit events are never updated or deleted in place.
Id of the user who initiated the command (NFR-AUD-01).
Display name of the user who initiated the command.
Unique identifier for the remediation action.
Which approved lifecycle command this audit event records (AD-003, command-concurrency skill).
The named server-side command that produced this audit event (AD-003).
Correlation id of the command execution, for tracing across the pipeline (NFR-OBS-01).
Optional structured detail for the command, for example a before and after summary. May hold JSON.
Idempotency key of the command run. Alternate key, so a replayed command upserts the same audit event rather than duplicating (NFR-REL-01, command-concurrency skill).
Short human-readable summary of the audit event.
When the command executed, on the server clock in UTC (NFR-AUD-01).
Mandatory reason captured for a correction command such as RegradeCase or a rejected sign-off (BR-012, AD-031).
Id of the record the command acted on.
Logical name of the table the command acted on.
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
Owner Id
Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.

Status of the Audit Event
